description: This file defines a generic class 'RepeatedFieldCopier<T>' that implements deep copying functionality for the 'RepeatedField<T>' collection type, used in serialization within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for deep copying collections and their elements, utilizing an injected copier for individual items.

classes.name: RepeatedFieldCopier<T>
classes.description: A sealed class implementing deep copying for 'RepeatedField<T>' collections, parameterized by element type T.

methods.name: RepeatedFieldCopier
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the copier with a deep copier for individual elements.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a 'RepeatedField<T>' collection, utilizing the context to avoid duplicate copies.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Copies elements from an input collection to an output collection, deep copying each element.
